svg.aria-label: Left panel: temperature against altitude from sea level to 11 kilometres for three hydrostatic atmospheres, an isothermal one, the International Standard Atmosphere, and a dry adiabat. Right panel: the pressure of the same three atmospheres divided by its sea-level value. The standard atmosphere lies between the other two, and the gap between it and the dry adiabat is the effect of latent heat.
svg.text: Standard atmosphere: ISO 2533 / US Standard Atmosphere 1976, defined by T(0) = 288.15 K, P(0) = 1.01325 bar and a lapse rate of 6.5 K/km.
